_comment: A reply that deliberately carries personal data, in its text and inside a tool call's arguments. The gateway does NOT rewrite a completion - rewriting a model's answer under the agent's feet would change structured outputs and tool-call arguments - but content reaches telemetry only through the walker, so the LLM span for this reply must show placeholders where these values are. That is what this script is for: a test the telemetry walk cannot pass by not looking. Note the walker's boundary rule skips LOCATION and DATE_TIME (pii_service.BOUNDARY_SKIP_ENTITIES, blueprint S4), so a place name in a reply is not a placeholder and nothing here relies on one being.
